Part of [`evoxc.numpy`](/api/evoxc/numpy/)

numpy.dot → ops.dot(a, b) (v1 alias of matmul).

Deviation: numpy's 1-D vector inner-product semantics for dot are not
special-cased in v1 — dot and matmul are identical here.
